en.headline: sogeisetsu: 6 commits to sopen-translate, 12 automated in profile repo
en.summary: On 2026-10-23, `sogeisetsu` made **6 own commits**, all in `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`. Page translation work led with a performance change that batches requests by provider policy and adds bounded concurrency plus adaptive splitting. A fix in the options and popup code keeps the model cache TTL honest and guards the restore status fetch. The glossary got a shipped offline-built builtin term list of 797 entries, and the project was bumped to `0.2.0` with docs synced to the bilingual and glossary work. Two smaller chores ignored locally installed agent skills and recorded C6 real-device acceptance results in the plan docs. Separately, `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` had 12 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. No pull requests, reviews, issues, releases, stars, replies, or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu：sopen-translate 6 次提交，个人主页仓库 12 次自动提交
zh.summary: 2026-10-23，`sogeisetsu` 共完成 **6 次本人提交**，全部位于 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`。页面翻译方面做出性能调整：按提供商策略批量请求，并加入有界并发与自适应拆分。选项与弹窗代码的修复让模型缓存 TTL 更准确，并为恢复状态请求加上保护。术语表方面新增了离线构建的内置词条列表，共 797 条，同时版本升至 `0.2.0`，文档也与双语和术语表工作同步。另有两项杂务提交：忽略本地安装的 agent skills，以及在计划文档中记录 C6 真机验收结果。此外，`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 有 12 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 完成的自动提交。当日没有 pull request、评审、issue、发布、star、回复或讨论记录。
